name: Lightning Strikes (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Quest #22: Friends in Need

disable: DC 15 Arcana,nature,thievery check (trained) two times to counter the planar energies.
routine: (3 actions) On its turn each round, the electrical discharge randomly targets two creatures dealing 2d4 electricity damage. A targeted creature must attempt a DC 15 basic Reflex save save.

items.name: Bolt from the Blue!

text: The air grows thick as the Planes of Metal and Air both bleed into the swamp once again. A small fissure opens, causing static electricity to build and, fueled by the increased presence of metal in the area, sparks begin to fly. Electrical discharges begin to break out reaching from objects to unlucky creatures.
